5aa5d8146 fixed some compilations issues and added more type information
c6a96fbcd TLO: Removed a throw statement that should've been removed in last update.
15d54d806 TLO: Eliminated the "fakethis... is not present in CallLocalityContext" runtime exception.  CallLocalityContext will now be a bit more liberal, assuming that previously unknown fields are acceptable when merging two contexts.
eb0a99747 HUGE change: - changed build script to Java 1.5 support - did generic type inference, fixed bugs found during that process - removed unnecessary imports and code - converted old-fashioned for-loops to new for(each)-loops, where automatic conversion was possible
cfd36e188 Changed name of dataflow package to infoflow.  Also changed all internal class, method, and field names to use the same terminology.
65f519dc1 Fixed CallLocalityContext.merge() to be more forgiving. Removed debug print statements. Improved TransactionBodyTransformer and TransactionAnalysis to try to make it work with more benchmarks.
650b5ee43 Converted LocalObjectsAnalysis to use a whole-call-graph propagation of shared/local values, rather than an all-call-chains propagation (which has an unacceptably slow worst-case run time).
7c7fcdf46 Added the ability to analyse the original locking structure of a program, for comparison to the generated locking structure. Added an interface for MHP Analyses. Fixed a bug with Local Objects Analysis.
86f8fd0eb Moved all thread related analyses and transformers (including mhp) into soot.jimple.toolkits.thread (they are ALL jimple-specific). Moved the data flow and local objects analyses into soot.jimple.toolkits.dataflow (except ThreadLocalObjectsAnaysis). Moved the local equivalence analyses into soot.jimple.toolkits.scalar. Moved NullnessAssumptionAnalysis into soot.jimple.toolkits.annotation.nullcheck.
9a984e969 Changed ThreadLocalObjectsAnalysis and LocalObjectsAnalysis to recognize the difference between the run() method and the other methods in a runnable's class. Fixed bug in CallChain.java. Turned off most debug printing in local objects code. Fixed bug in TransactionBodyTransformer.  Currently seeking more :-)
acbf90328 Introduced a more streamlined algorithm for the construction of Data Flow Graphs and for using those graphs to check wether a value is local or shared.  Also cleaned up some of the dead code in the local objects and data flow analyses.
96b54a574 Improved scalability of ThreadLocalObjectsAnalysis.  It will now run on the DaCapo eclipse benchmark.
4c738f1fb Added ThreadLocalObjectsAnalysis, and made numerous changes to other local objects analysis classes to support it. Made performance improvements to UnsynchronizedMhpAnalysis and its components.

This confirms the b

ug traces to a single commit.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 70435f456d73b3ee2

asoning

**(1) Investigation:** The "fix" commit (5aa5d8146) isn't a behavioral bug fix —
it's a compile-error fix ("fixed some compilations issues and added more type information"). I looked at the commit right before it in history, `70435f456 "Make classes in soot.
toolkits.graph generic"` (merged via PR #362, `2c40357f4`), which converted `DominatorNode`, `DominatorTree`, `MHG
DominatorTree`, `HashMutableDirectedGraph`-consumers (`ClassInfoFlowAnalysis`, `SimpleMethodInfoFlowAnalysis`), et
c. to use generics. I compared the class definitions before/after that commit and cross-referenced with `build.xml`, which p

ins the main source compile to `-source 1.6 -target 1.6`.

**(2) Specific changes that introduced the bug:**
- In `SimpleMethodInfoFlowAnalysis.java`, `70435f456` introduced di
amond-operator instantiations such as `new Pair<>(sinkEqVal, sourceEqVal)`. The diamond operator (`<>`) is a Java 7 language feature, but the project's `build.x
ml` explicitly compiles the main source tree with `source="1.6" target="1.6"`. This makes the diamond-operator code fail to compile under the project's mandated comp
iler settings — exactly the kind of "compilation issue" the fix commit addresses (it replaces every `new Pair<>(...)` with the explicit `new Pair<EquivalentValue,

EquivalentValue>(...)`).
